RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the May 14, 2002/Vaisakha 24, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministrie:  Civil Aviation; Commerce and Industry; Finance; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—20
206
Visa-on-arrival scheme
*681. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of TOURISM AND CULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention
has been drawn to the news-item which
appeared in The Hindustan Times dated
the 12th April, 2002, to the effect that the
'Visa-on-arrival' scheme announced to be
operational from 1st April, 2002, is likely
to be delayed considerably due to various
constraints and differences in perception
of concerned Ministries, like Home
Affairs, Civil Aviation, etc.; and
(b) if so, the details of difficulties being
encountered and the steps taken to remove
the bottlenecks so as to implement the
scheme in a time-bound manner to boost
the sagging tourism industry?
Grant for Chhattisgarh under
Library Development Scheme
†*682. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of TOURISM AND
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
a demand for additional grant for state
level library under the Library
Development Scheme from the
Government of Chhattisgarh;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when necessary orders in this
regard will be issued by Government?
World Bank Loan to Andhra Pradesh
†*683. SHRI B.P. SINGHAL: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether World Bank is extending
a monetary loan of 250 million dollars to
the Andhra Pradesh Government;
(b) whether the Department for
International Development (DFID) of
Britain has also offered to extend
monetary loan to any other State;
(c) whether Government have
permitted both of them to extend loans;
and
(d) if so, whether the direct inflow of
foreign money in States will endanger the
sovereignty and unity of India?
Airstrips in Rajasthan
†*684. DR. ABRAR AHMED: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

207
WIN2\SESSION\858rs 207
(a) the places in Rajasthan where new
airstrips are proposed to be constructed
alongwith the cost of each of these
airstrips and the present status of the one
proposed to be constructed at Ajmer;
(b) whether Government propose to
construct an airstrip at Sawai Madhopur,
a major tourist spot in Rajasthan which is
also famous for Ranthambor Tiger Project
and whether Government are aware that
it will boost tourist industry of the
country; and
(c) by when, international flights will
be introduced from Jaipur, one of the
major airports of Rajasthan?
Coffee production
*685. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of annual coffee
production and consumption in the
country during the last three years;
(b) whether it is a fact that supply of
coffee has outstripped the demand in the
country resulting in a loss of remunerative
prices for the coffee growers;
(c) if so, the details in this regard;
(d) whether coffee growers in the
country have demanded relief measures
from the Central Government for tiding
over the crisis faced by them; and
(e) if so, the details in this regard and
Government's reaction thereto?
Debts of Highly Indebted Poor
countries
*686. SHRI ABANI ROY:
SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
announced their decision to write-off the
debt owned to it by the highly indebted
poor countries;
(b) if so, the names of the highly
indebted poor countries in the World to
whom India has provided loans;
(c) the quantum of debt owned by those
countries and under what terms and
conditions such loans were given; and
(d) the advantage to Government for
writing off such debts?
Scarcity of water in Rajasthan
†*687. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Rajasthan falls under the
category of worst affected State as far as
potable water is concerned;
(b) whether there is a acute scarcity of
potable water in Rajasthan and many
districts of the State have to face the
problem of polluted and floride
contaminated water;
(c) whether any scheme is under
Government's consideration to provide
Rajasthan with some special financial
package to make available pure potable
water to the people of Rajasthan placing
the State under special category in respect
of crisis of potable water under the
National water policy; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Acquisition of aircrafts by Air India

 DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:

own plan to acquire 23 new aircrafts over

losses continuously for

Sale of AI property in Mauritius
4953. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether  the residential property
owned by Air India in Mauritius is being
sold;
(b) if so, the details  thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the details of the plan to invest the
amount received from the above deal?
Compensation to off loaded
passengers by AI
4954. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Air India gives compen-
sation to passengers off loaded from US-
bound flights;
(b) whether similar compensation is not
offered by Air India to travellers off loaded
from flights bound for other destinations;
(c) whether some foreign airlines do pay
such amount in small sums and some even
don't pay;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) the steps being taken to remove the
anomaly?
Fall in passenger load in national
carrier
4955. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that passenger
load have fallen in national air carrier
because of the competition from Jet and
Sahara airways; and
(b) if so, in what manner Government
propose to come out of such a situation?
World class airports in metropolitan
cities
4956. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
upgrade international airports in metropolitan
cities to the standards of world class
airports;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) in what manner these projects are
proposed to be financed?

1084
WIN2\SESSION\752RS 1084
Snag in PM's  plane  at
Singapore airport
4957. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether most of the fleet of
aeroplanes with the Indian Airlines is more
than ten years old;
(b) if so, the age-wise details of the
aeroplanes;
(c) whether the plane which carried the
Prime Minister to Singapore and Cambodia
recently developed snags at the Singapore
Airport;
(d) if so, the details in this regard; and
(e) the steps being taken to replace and
renew the fleet?
Fare structure of IA for
NE Region
4958. SHRI LAJPAT RAI: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are offering a bailout package to Indian
Airlines;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government are planning to
rationalize the fare structure especially with
reference to North Eastern sectors to
compensate the losses; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Hand trolleys at Hyderabad
Airport
4959. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether old designed and insufficient
number of hand trolleys are in use at the
Hyderabad Airport both at domestic and
international terminals;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action Government propose to
take to make available new modern designed
hand trolleys in sufficient number at
Hyderabad Airport within a time-frame?
Amritsar airport
4960. SHRI SUKHBIR SINGH: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to refer to answer to Unstarred
Question 3651 given in the Rajya Sabha on
30th April, 2002 and state:
(a) the details of ongoing projects for
development of Amritsar Airport both
national and international indicating the target
set for commissioning;
(b) the details of introduction of
international flights to and from Amritsar;
and
(c) the flights to be started in the near
future?
DME at Madurai Airport
4961. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up High Power Distance Measuring
Equipment (DME) at Madurai Airport
considering such facilities have been
extended even to smaller airports;
(b) if so, the  details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

Participation of foreign investors in
domestic flights
†4962. SHRI JANESHW AR
MISHRA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that all the aeroplane
manufacturing countries in the world are
competing with each other to influence and
create market in India;
(b) if so, the number of owners of foreign
aeroplane manufacturing companies who
participated in International Aerospace
Conference held in Hyderabad recently;
(c) whether Government have also
invited the foreign investors to participate
in domestic flights; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Credentials of private airlines

SHRI C.O. POULOSE:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATI
